assumptions: Human-answered fork: option 1 -- starling leaves out a logical run with fewer than shard.total distinct shard indices and names it in its notes (stderr), like a left-out history row. No contract or schema change.
A run's required shard count is the largest shard.total among its records; an index above that total is not counted as one of its shards, and a duplicate index counts once.
The left-out run is dropped before the 30-run window, so the newest COMPLETE run carries per-test results and the flaky window counts only complete runs.

selectRuns takes notes as an optional second argument (default: a throwaway list) so its existing callers and tests are unchanged; the only production caller, inputs.mjs readInputs, passes the CLI's notes.
Scope kept to run selection: agents/skills/lib/contracts/ (lane #1154) and the katana register path (#1199) are untouched.
